Read [Extending KISS My Agent](../../docs/EXTENDING.md) before proposing new skill content.

## Recurring ambiguity

What current decision is not adequately covered, and in which real situations does it recur?

## Current consumer

Who will use the decision and what outcome changes?

## Proposed owner

Choose one: permanent `AGENTS.md` boundary, existing Rule revision, new Rule, existing Case revision, or new Case. Explain why the other owners are insufficient.

## Minimum addition

Provide the smallest wording or contrast that resolves the ambiguity.

## Overlap check

Which existing rule, Rent Test item, mechanism semantic, evidence method, or Case is closest? Explain why this proposal is not a near-duplicate.

## Deletion counterfactual

If the proposed material were removed, which current decision would become materially worse or ambiguous?

## Non-goals

State what this proposal must not expand into, such as workflow, governance, compatibility, telemetry, or evaluation machinery.
